_comment: Single source of truth for the About page gallery. 'thumb' and 'master' are asset paths without extension: layouts/shortcodes/gallery.html appends .webp and .jpg and resolves both through resources.Get, so a missing derivative fails the build instead of 404-ing at runtime. Derivatives are generated by scripts/build-gallery.sh. Display order is the order of this array.
